audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Israel's descent to Egypt, Beer-sheba vision, divine promise, household list, seventy persons, Judah sent ahead, and Joseph/Jacob reunion.

verses.restored: Israel journeyed with all that was his, came to Beersheba, and sacrificed sacrifices to the Divine of his father Isaac.

familiar.text: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

verses.restored: The Divine spoke to Israel in visions of the night and said, Jacob, Jacob. He said, Here I am.

familiar.text: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

verses.restored: He said, I am the Divine, the Divine of your father. Do not fear to go down to Egypt, for there I will make you into a great nation.

familiar.text: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

verses.restored: I myself will go down with you to Egypt, and I myself will surely bring you up again; and Joseph shall put his hand on your eyes.

familiar.text: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

verses.restored: Jacob rose from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, their little ones, and their women in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

familiar.text: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

verses.restored: They took their livestock and their possessions acquired in Canaan and came to Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him.

familiar.text: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

verses.restored: His sons and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters and his sons’ daughters, all his seed he brought with him to Egypt.

familiar.text: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

verses.restored: These are the names of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt: Jacob and his sons; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

familiar.text: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

verses.restored: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

familiar.text: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.restored: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul son of a Canaanite woman.

familiar.text: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

verses.restored: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

familiar.text: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.restored: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

familiar.text: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.restored: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.

familiar.text: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

verses.restored: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

familiar.text: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

verses.restored: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan-Aram, together with Dinah his daughter; all the persons of his sons and daughters were thirty-three.

familiar.text: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

verses.restored: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

familiar.text: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

verses.restored: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

familiar.text: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

verses.restored: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; these she bore to Jacob, sixteen persons.

familiar.text: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

verses.restored: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s woman: Joseph and Benjamin.

familiar.text: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

verses.restored: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath daughter of Potiphera priest of On bore to him.

familiar.text: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.

verses.restored: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

familiar.text: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

verses.restored: These are the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob, fourteen persons in all.

familiar.text: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

verses.restored: The son of Dan: Hushim.

familiar.text: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

verses.restored: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

familiar.text: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

verses.restored: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter; these she bore to Jacob, seven persons in all.

familiar.text: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

verses.restored: All the persons belonging to Jacob who came to Egypt, who came out of his loins, not including the women of Jacob’s sons, were sixty-six persons in all.

familiar.text: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

verses.restored: The sons of Joseph who were born to him in Egypt were two persons. All the persons of the house of Jacob who came to Egypt were seventy.

familiar.text: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

verses.restored: He sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came to the land of Goshen.

familiar.text: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

verses.restored: Joseph harnessed his chariot and went up to meet Israel his father in Goshen. He appeared to him, fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a long time.

familiar.text: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

verses.restored: Israel said to Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you are still alive.

familiar.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

verses.restored: Joseph said to his brothers and his father’s house, I will go up and tell Pharaoh, My brothers and my father’s house, who were in Canaan, have come to me.

familiar.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

verses.restored: The men are shepherds, keepers of livestock; they have brought their flocks, herds, and all that is theirs.

familiar.text: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

verses.restored: When Pharaoh calls you and says, What is your work?

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

verses.restored: you shall say, Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth until now, both we and our fathers, so that you may dwell in the land of Goshen, for every shepherd of flocks is an abomination to Egypt.

familiar.text: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
